head: working-tree
subject: unblock macOS portable cross-compilation
change: Bumped the pinned Vort revision to a48e1151, which emits Brotli counted-context code through the platform code_sections table instead of an ELF-style dotted section name. Added explicit macOS SDK framework, library, and include paths to the vail module when an explicit -Dtarget selects macOS, because explicit targets disable Zig's automatic SDK discovery. CI now compiles aarch64-macos-none and x86_64-macos-none on macos-latest instead of ubuntu-latest, where the Security/CoreFoundation frameworks are unavailable.

duplex_and_pool.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter=duplex handle; zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter=streams a request over a leased connection

notes: The pinned Vort revision is a48e1151872a30a574363e994ec312969b3c7818 in source_archive.py, ci.yml, and release.yml. The 2026-11-08 evidence remains as the historical blocked-state record. A non-macOS host can cross-compile these targets by passing -Dmacos-sdk=<sdk root>; CI validates them on macos-latest where std.zig.system.darwin.getSdk discovers the runner SDK.
